create_WhisperProcessor: create a WhisperProcessor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer for audio transcription
call_WhisperProcessor_audio: call the WhisperProcessor to extract audio features from raw audio samples and sampling rate
call_WhisperProcessor_text: call the WhisperProcessor to tokenize text input and return encoded input IDs
call_WhisperProcessor_audio_text: call the WhisperProcessor with both audio and text to produce feature inputs with labels for training
get_decoder_prompt_ids: get decoder prompt IDs for a specified task, language, and timestamp setting
